description: Marks one error group resolved (errorId), or up to 100 at once (errorIds) for duplicates fixed by the same change, with an optional note such as the fixing commit. A group reopens on its own if the error happens again. Returns what changed.

errorIds.description: Several error IDs to resolve with the same note (up to 100)

name: runheed_resolve_error
